# Supplied homepage background images

- `grass-sky.png`: unchanged copy of `image(20261005-192128).png` (1200 × 1200).
- `breeze-field.png`: unchanged copy of `image(20261005-192203).png` (641 × 360).
- `open-meadow.png`: unchanged copy of `image(20261005-192317).png` (720 × 404).

All three were supplied by the user. Original image content, including visible source markings, is retained. Cropping, fading, saturation, and edge blending happen through CSS on the homepage. The images are decorative and hidden from screen readers. The foreground name, introduction, navigation, and framed artworks remain independent editable content.
